meaning:
1) breath, spirit
1a) breath (of God)
1b) breath (of man)
1c) every breathing thing
1d) spirit (of man)
Aramaic equivalent: nish.ma (נִשְׁמָא "breath" H5396)

renderings.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath

elsewhere.note: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;
So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed…
Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him; according to the saying…
By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
